title: HDT Scripts\UI\wizard.yaml
description: The technician wizard's pages, in the order they are asked. MDT's DeployWiz_Definition_ENU.xml, which lists one <Pane id= reference= /> per screen with a <Condition> deciding whether it appears - and PSD's Classic_Theme_Definitions_en-US.xml, which lists the same panes the same way. A share with no wizard.yaml has NO WIZARD, which is what keeps an image built before this existed deploying with nobody present.

title.description: The window title. Omitted, the wizard uses its own.

pages.description: In the order they are asked. An empty list is legal and means no wizard.

id.description: Stable, and what a skip variable is named after. MDT's Pane id=.

title.description: What the rail shows. Omitted, the id is used.

reference.description: The page's markup, relative to Scripts\UI on the share. MDT's Pane reference=. Never rooted and never containing '..' - a definition file is authored content and must not be able to name a path outside the share.

skip.description: The variable that hides this page. MDT's <Condition> tests exactly this. Omitted, the page cannot be skipped individually - HDTSkipWizard still hides it.

validate.description: A control on this page whose contents are judged as they are typed.

rule.description: A rule this engine implements. A name it does not know is refused rather than ignored, because a control that silently never validates looks like a wizard that accepts anything.

summary.description: Marks this as the summary page and names the controls the engine fills.

collect.description: What this page fills in. One entry per variable; MDT's panes set properties the same way.

property.description: The control property to read. Text for a TextBox, SelectedValue for a list or a combo, Password for a PasswordBox. Omitted, Text.

isSecret.description: Never shown on the summary and never written into the rules.yaml snippet. HDTDomainAdminPassword is the case this exists for.

split.description: Splits one typed value across two variables. AccountName turns CORP\svc into the account and its domain.

splitVariable.description: Where the second half goes. Required when split is set.

splitDefaultFrom.description: The variable to fall back to when the typed value carried no domain. For a join account this is HDTJoinDomain - a bare account belongs to the domain being joined.

optional.description: The skip check does not demand this one. For a page with two mutually exclusive halves - MDT's Computer Details offers a domain OR a workgroup - only the half the machine is getting has to be supplied.

select.description: How many values this control answers with. 'one' - the default - reads the named property off the control. 'many' reads every row of an ItemsControl and joins the ids of the ticked ones with ', ', which is what the Applications page needs and what Invoke-HDTInstallApplicationsStep splits back apart. The rows carry Id and IsSelected by convention, the way a picker's rows carry SelectedValuePath.
